channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [repo] CajasiZep76/local-ai-chat-uncensored
item.description: Portable Windows runtime suite that provides private, offline, and unfiltered AI chat with character presets and hot-reloadable configuration.

item.title: [repo] francoisokada/llm-key-pool
item.description: Portable Windows utility that manages a multi-provider API key pool with automatic 429 rotation and hot-reloadable configuration.

item.title: [repo] TegevoXi39/ccu-tool
item.description: TegevoXi39/ccu-tool provides a native 64-bit portable session rotation engine for Claude Code CLI to maintain uninterrupted workflows.

item.title: [news] Introducing the Amazon Bedrock Trusted Access API with Anthropic’s Enterprise Frontier Safeguards and Enterprise Data Controls
item.description: Amazon Bedrock API that provides a single interface to discover, request, and enroll in model provider trusted access programs.

item.title: [news] datasette-charts 0.2a0
item.description: Plugin for Datasette that integrates with Datasette Agent to generate charts dynamically from user chat prompts.

item.title: [news] datasette-agent 0.7a1
item.description: Update for Datasette Agent that enables chat sessions to open side-panel iframes capable of navigating across different pages.

item.title: [repo] brainintelli/BioSignal-Guided-LLM-Reinforcement-Learning
item.description: Research codebase exploring how offline replay of organoid neural activity affects language model agent behavior and survival in a game environment.

item.title: [news] GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
item.description: Z.ai releases GLM-5.4, an AI model that utilizes a looped transformer architecture for generalized coding tasks.

item.title: [repo] SerapoQosa58/uncensored-ai-chat
item.description: Portable Windows runtime suite offering a local, private, and unfiltered AI chat interface with hot-reloadable configuration.

item.title: [repo] ebbapanagiotou44/llm-key-rotator
item.description: Portable Windows utility that pools multiple API keys to prevent rate limit errors through automatic rotation.

item.title: [paper] Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action
item.description: Method called MoOP that combines reasoning and trajectory objectives to structurally prune vision-language-action models for autonomous driving while maintaining performance.

item.title: [paper] Lyris: Layout-Guided Long Video Generation with Persistent 3D Memory
item.description: Long video generation framework called Lyris that uses a persistent point-cloud memory and a vision-language model to create consistent camera-controlled walkthroughs from a single photo.

item.title: [paper] Modern Self-Supervised Vision Transformers Are Pareidolic
item.description: Study finding that modern self-supervised Vision Transformers contain a pareidolic subspace that hinders object emergence, which can be mitigated using a training-free calibration method called PSC.

item.title: [paper] Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
item.description: Integral converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space, extending understanding capabilities to strong visual generation.

item.title: [paper] TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
item.description: TowerBridge is a weight-space programming recipe that bridges the CLIP dual-encoder modality gap to significantly improve image and text retrieval accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Language Models Steer on Injected Uncertainty Tokens, but Fail to Self-Monitor In Situ
item.description: Evaluations across math benchmarks demonstrate that open-weights language models fail to monitor their own in-situ reasoning errors despite steering well on injected uncertainty tokens.

item.title: [paper] How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
item.description: BiPert is a linear framework for single-cell perturbation modeling that predicts gene expression changes in unseen cell lines and identifies perturbed genes from transcriptional profiles.

item.title: [paper] Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
item.description: Mutual Information Prototype Alignment is a self-supervised dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information for improved neural network training.

item.title: [paper] Agentic AI for Intent Management and Control in Autonomous Communication Networks
item.description: A triadic agentic AI framework co-designs intent management and fulfillment using a language model interpreter, optimizer, and controller to enable adaptive autonomous network operations.

item.title: [paper] CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans
item.description: CTLink is a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that links radiology report findings to specific regions in chest CT scans.

item.title: [paper] LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be
item.description: PolarReg is a simple regularization term that enforces marginal distributions of magnitude and direction in self-supervised encoders without requiring strict independence.

item.title: [paper] Seeking in Space: Benchmarking Purposeful Active Exploration of Vision-Language Models for Spatial Reasoning
item.description: ActSpace-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating purposeful active exploration in vision-language models, revealing that top models seek evidence but are limited by memory.

item.title: [paper] Flood forecasting using a physics-guided conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model
item.description: A conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model provides fast, high-resolution ensemble flood forecasting by leveraging historical storm simulations and coarse hydrodynamic conditioning.

item.title: [paper] Verifying the Outputs of PDE Solvers: From Finite Elements to Neural Surrogates
item.description: Framework that uses a small independent checker to verify the outputs of PDE solvers and neural surrogates, providing guaranteed error bounds against a written physics specification.

item.title: [paper] WorldLatent: A Unified 4D Latent Space for World Perception and Generation
item.description: Framework that introduces a unified 4D latent space to compress and fuse visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics into a single representation for simultaneous world perception and generation.

item.title: [paper] Matching Under Metric Privacy
item.description: Method that randomizes private points or their distances to public points in Euclidean space to obtain accurate bipartite matchings under metric privacy while providing privacy and utility guarantees.

item.title: [paper] ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
item.description: Automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library to improve multimodal search agents across diverse benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Learning Neurovascular Codes for EEG-to-fMRI Synthesis
item.description: Model that learns shared neurovascular codes as EEG representations using stochastic interpolants to synthesize and sample diverse fMRI signals from EEG windows.

item.title: [paper] Know When to Abstain: Conformal Confidence Estimation for Text-to-SQL
item.description: Probabilistic query validation framework that combines a generator and a critic model with conformal calibration to estimate confidence and control error rates in Text-to-SQL systems.

item.title: [paper] CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
item.description: Reward-agnostic attribution framework that uses role-level policy grafting and Shapley values to decompose and analyze reinforcement learning gains across different functional roles in search agents.

item.title: [paper] On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation
item.description: Method that combines classical video codec-based token pruning with on-site self-distillation to speed up video generation and reduce memory usage by eliminating redundant condition tokens.

item.title: [paper] Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions
item.description: Conversational recommendation system that ranks items using typed decisions and option probabilities instead of generated text, offering faster responses and lower costs than LLM rankers.

item.title: [paper] Reducing Order Sensitivity in Decision Models
item.description: Method utilizing tree attention to achieve order invariance in decision models, reducing order sensitivity and improving reliability with little to no loss in predictive accuracy.

item.title: [paper] EEG Decoding in Context: A Framework for Tuning-Free EEG Foundation Models
item.description: Framework that combines EEG-specific context construction with a frozen in-context predictor and metric-based adaptation to decode EEG signals without task-specific fine-tuning.

item.title: [paper] Precision-Aware Learning Rate Transfer Across Block Count in LLM Post-Training
item.description: Method called TipSweep that transfers learning rates across different numbers of trainable transformer blocks during large language model post-training to reduce tuning costs.

item.title: [paper] When Does Overriding the Majority Vote Help?
item.description: Comparative analysis of when additional reasoning, executed programs, or cross-model reasoning can successfully override majority-vote answers in language models.

item.title: [paper] SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning
item.description: Method called SPROUT that uses a text-only utility predictor and a randomized acceptance rule to select informative training prompts for efficient text-to-image preference tuning.

item.title: [paper] Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models
item.description: Approach for few-step autoregressive video generation that applies anti-drifting guidance and motion-aware guidance to improve FlowMap distillation quality and reduce rollout drift.

item.title: [paper] Habitats: A Framework for Open-Ended Evolution of Agent Objectives
item.description: Framework called Habitats that maintains an evolving population of reward-policy pairs to generate diverse and high-performing executable agent objectives automatically.

item.title: [paper] Tokens as Locality-Preserving Anchors: Scalable Novel View Synthesis with Target-Adaptive Token Routing
item.description: Transformer-based view synthesis model that uses a target-adaptive token router to select a fixed budget of spatial anchor tokens, enabling fast and scalable novel view rendering.

item.title: [paper] Attention Latent Feedback
item.description: Architecture called Attention Latent Feedback that allows sublayers in autoregressive decoding to attend to deeper layer outputs from previous positions, improving language model performance.

item.title: [paper] Optimal Regret Lower Bounds in Matrix Games
item.description: Theoretical study establishing optimal regret lower bounds of deterministic learning dynamics in two-player zero-sum matrix games.

item.title: [repo] SodovaFo7/claude-code-unlimited
item.description: SodovaFo7/claude-code-unlimited is a session rotation engine for Claude Code CLI that automatically detects limit messages and rotates sessions in place.

item.title: [paper] Head Anything: Correspondence-Guided Joint Generation of 3D Heads from Few Images
item.description: Framework called Head Anything that converts a pretrained single-image 3D head generator into a joint multi-image generator using lightweight correspondence-attention adapters.

item.title: [paper] HoloSplat: Real-Time Token Streaming for Feed-Forward Human Reconstruction
item.description: HoloSplat is a real-time streaming framework for human-centric volumetric video that uses server-side token compression and client-side restoration to stream high-quality 3D Gaussians at high frame rates.

item.title: [paper] Deneb-Vritra: Descriptions, Edges and Names Examined by Blocking Via Restoring Token Representations and Attention
item.description: Laya is a 421M-parameter encoder that evaluates text questions, and researchers show that blocking attention from answer markers to specific name tokens in middle layers significantly reduces name shortcuts without hurting overall accuracy.

item.title: [paper] SRCWDNet: Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network for Multi-Label Remote Sensing Scene Classification
item.description: SRCWDNet is a semantic-relational cross-window dual-graph network designed to improve multi-label remote sensing scene classification by jointly modeling visual attention and adaptive label correlations.

item.title: [paper] Serialization and the Character-System: Measuring Narrative Concentration in French Fiction (1800--1940)
item.description: Researchers analyze narrative concentration across 12,011 French novels published between 1800 and 1940 using the Gini coefficient of PageRank distributions over character networks, finding a U-shaped trajectory over the nineteenth century.

item.title: [paper] Genome-to-Image Translation: Reconstructing Escherichia coli Morphology from Genomic Sequences
item.description: Researchers propose a conditional image-generation method using whole-genome sequencing data and a generative adversarial network to reconstruct Escherichia coli colony morphology and improve antimicrobial resistance classification.

item.title: [paper] FATCAT: Fault Injection Attacks Targeting Chip-level Alignment
item.description: FATCAT is a physical electromagnetic fault-injection attack that targets GPU-accelerated systems to corrupt memory transactions and eliminate safety refusal mechanisms in modern large language and vision-language models.

item.title: [paper] CrownFusion: 3D Dental Crown Generation Using Geometry Images and Latent Diffusion
item.description: CrownFusion is a latent diffusion model that generates 3D dental crown designs from geometry images while preserving fine geometric detail and producing anatomically plausible variations tailored to individual patients.

item.title: [paper] Data-Driven Identification of Uncertainty Sets with Conformance Guarantees
item.description: ConfID is a unified framework that establishes reachset, trace, and simulation conformance for nonlinear systems by identifying data-driven uncertainty sets with distribution-free probabilistic guarantees.

item.title: [paper] WeaveVLA: 3D Relational Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Models
item.description: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for instruction-conditioned robot control, yet their understanding of task-relevant 3D relations and how these relations evolve during manipulation remains largely implicit.

item.title: [paper] Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure for Subsurface Seepage Forecasting and Relief Placement
item.description: Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure is a modeling approach that maps local physical descriptors to exchange coefficients at cut boundaries to improve subsurface seepage forecasting and relief placement.

item.title: [paper] Self-Upgrading Embodied Agents
item.description: Researchers introduce a self-upgrading embodied agent that learns from its daily experiences by autonomously testing and rewriting a tensor of its own weights between tasks without requiring gradient training or external reward models.

item.title: [paper] RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
item.description: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging.

item.title: [paper] Attention Temperature Confounds Zero-Shot Context Extension
item.description: Method for LLM zero-context extension that calibrates attention temperature to remove miscalibration artifacts and false advantages from baseline comparisons.

item.title: [paper] Look Back, Draft Ahead: Corrective Prefix Attention for Parallel Speculative Decoding
item.description: Parallel speculative decoding method called Corrective Prefix Attention that combines prefix selection with autoregressive supervision to accelerate token generation.

item.title: [paper] Preflight: Agentic Last-Mile Verification for AI Software Supply Chains
item.description: Program-scoped pre-execution verifier called Preflight that analyzes Python dependencies in a restricted environment to detect malicious behavior for downstream applications.

item.title: [paper] LiveLoRA: Exact KV Cache Migration Across LoRA Updates for LLM Agents
item.description: Model-runtime co-design called LiveLora that enables exact final-block key-value cache migration across adapter updates without replaying full interaction histories.

item.title: [paper] SayWhen: Set-Valued Semantic Commitment for Low-Regret Early Speech
item.description: Test-time controller called SayWhen that manages early speech release in voice agents using semantic vetoes and schema-derived continuation plans.

item.title: [paper] NoveltyGate: Novelty, Not Error, Decides Which VLA Prefix Tokens to Compute Exactly
item.description: Training-free routing method called NoveltyGate that accelerates vision-language-action model prefixes by sending tokens to low-rank or original MLPs based on novelty.

item.title: [paper] Leakage-Safe Auditing of Attribution-Driven Data Curation in Medical Imaging
item.description: Auditing framework for attribution-driven medical imaging curation that evaluates anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility.

item.title: [paper] Tradeoffs between objective outcomes and human enjoyment of work in human-AI task allocation
item.description: Behavioral study framework that assesses how people and large language models balance objective performance and human enjoyment when allocating tasks.

item.title: [paper] Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
item.description: Finetuning approach called LoopRes that adds loop residuals and trainable keys to pretrained transformers to improve performance in looped architectures.

item.title: [paper] Revisiting Learning to Delegate: LLM Discovered Heuristics for Large-Scale Vehicle Routing
item.description: Automatic heuristic design framework that uses large language models to discover generalizable heuristics for solving large-scale vehicle routing problems.

item.title: [paper] Orthogonally Mixed Sign Coding with Progressive Residual Refinement for Transformer Weight Compression
item.description: Progressive residual-sign quantization framework that uses randomized orthogonal mixing to compress Transformer weights and maintain predictive fidelity without learned codebooks.

item.title: [paper] AI-Assisted Programming and Labor Demand
item.description: Study examining how firm-level adoption of GitHub Copilot reduces junior technical hiring and shifts labor demand toward more experienced workers.

item.title: [paper] ChiProgramBench: Can LLM Agents Rebuild Efficient Circuits from Pin-Level Experiments?
item.description: ChiProgramBench benchmark evaluating whether large language model agents can rebuild efficient hardware circuits from pin-level experiments and black-box interactions.

item.title: [paper] Wrist-Camera Video Diffusion as Generalizable Robot Policies
item.description: Wrist Video Policy framework that predicts future wrist-camera views and uses geometric estimation to generate generalizable robot manipulation policies across multiple embodiments.

item.title: [paper] AlphaDefect: Expert-Level AI for Slay the Spire 2
item.description: AlphaDefect reinforcement learning agent that achieves expert-level performance in the deck-building video game Slay the Spire 2.

item.title: [paper] UMAMI: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Evidence-Grounded Dietary Decisions
item.description: Unified Multimodal Assessment of Meals and Intake dataset and benchmark for evaluating multimodal systems on evidence-grounded dietary decisions.

item.title: [paper] Decoupling Solving from Abstention: Single-Rollout Conformal Risk Control for Hard-Budget LLM Reasoning
item.description: Tail-CRC single-rollout framework that combines budget forcing and conformal risk control to manage expected wrong submissions in large language model reasoning.

item.title: [paper] A Comparison of Uncertainty in AI and Dynamical Climate Ensembles
item.description: Systematic comparison evaluating uncertainty representation and internal variability in ensembles of state-of-the-art artificial intelligence and dynamical climate models.

item.title: [paper] From Local Errors to System Failures: Modeling and Benchmarking Error Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
item.description: Response-Aware Error Propagation structural model for connecting measured local responses to system-level error propagation in multi-agent large language model systems.

item.title: [paper] DKnown-Jev-2: Article-Level Answer-Evidence Classification and Efficient Inference with a Pre-trained Language Model
item.description: DKnown-Jev-2 article-level answer evidence classifier that jointly encodes question conditions and paragraph content to perform low-latency evidence selection for normative question answering.

item.title: [paper] CAST: A Deployed Speech-to-Text Cascade for Closed Captioning of Entertainment Television
item.description: Captioning ASR Stack for Television is an integrated speech-to-text pipeline that combines Whisper large-v3 with hierarchical voice activity detection to improve closed captioning accuracy for entertainment television.

item.title: [paper] From Head to Tail: LLM-Augmented Sequential Recommendation and Trade-off Optimization
item.description: Group-specific data augmentation approach leverages large language models to generate synthetic interactions, improving recommendation performance for long-tail items in recommender systems.

item.title: [paper] Automatic Occupational Coding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation
item.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework named OPERAG enables automated occupational classification across any standard without requiring expert-labelled training databases.

item.title: [paper] RoFE: Rotated Frozen Embeddings for Low-Data Multimodal Tabular Learning
item.description: Rotated Frozen Embeddings is a training-free method that rotates principal component analysis scores before tabular foundation model inference to improve low-data multimodal tabular learning.

item.title: [paper] Distill the Correction, Not the Rewrite: Hindsight Twins for Self-Improving Text-to-Image Models
item.description: Hindsight Twins improves text-to-image alignment by distilling the velocity difference between twin prompt revisions while avoiding critic-induced bias.

item.title: [paper] Revealing Geometry under Strong Noise: Spectral Embeddings and Clustering via Random Geometric Graphs
item.description: New spectral embedding and clustering method uses cross-fitted projections and random geometric graphs to denoise pairwise distances and reveal latent nonlinear structures under strong noise.

item.title: [paper] Grower-in-the-loop AI for Deployable Precision Fertilisation in Sustainable Agriculture
item.description: Grower-in-the-loop framework combines baseline nitrogen-response planning with large language model adaptation to generate practical precision fertilization schedules for sustainable agriculture.

item.title: [paper] Boltz-Flow: Generating High-Quality Robot Action from Boltzmann Machine
item.description: Boltz-Flow replaces Gaussian initialization with a conditional Boltzmann machine in flow-matching policies to improve robot action generation across diverse tasks.

item.title: [paper] Déjà VAE: When Do Autoencoder Traces Reveal Generated Images?
item.description: Reconstruction-based detector uses autoencoder traces to identify generated images without training, while highlighting vulnerabilities to common image transformations.

item.title: [paper] AI-Assisted Auto-formalization for Trustworthy Scientific Computing: Case Studies and Lessons Learned
item.description: Systematic study evaluates agentic AI tools for auto-formalization in scientific computing, identifying cross-layer failure modes and workflows to preserve mathematical soundness.

item.title: [paper] Black-Box Comparator-Adaptive Network Regret
item.description: Black-box reduction uses local learners to achieve sublinear comparator-adaptive network regret in decentralized online learning with only one gossip step per round.

item.title: [paper] ComputeWise: Measuring and Fixing GPU Waste by AI Research Agents
item.description: Open-source benchmark and harness called ComputeWise uses a simulated GPU to measure and remove wasted GPU time in AI research agents, improving execution efficiency across multiple models.

item.title: [paper] Self-Supervised Learning for Soft-Constrained AC-OPF in Multiphase Distribution Systems
item.description: Self-supervised learning framework uses a neural network and differentiable power flow to predict setpoints for optimal power flow in multiphase distribution systems without requiring optimal-solution labels.

item.title: [paper] Token Pruning Needs a Protected Sink Token: Coherent Spatial Aggregation in Vision Transformers
item.description: Monte Carlo Token Pruning is a method that evaluates how vision transformers respond to token removal and shows that models require protected sink tokens to maintain spatial coherence.

item.title: [paper] WildAnySplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild
item.description: WildAnySplat is a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that uses a student-teacher training strategy to perform robust novel-view synthesis from in-the-wild multi-view images with appearance variations.

item.title: [paper] OmniV-Bench: Can MLLMs Comprehend Immersive Spatio-temporal Scenes?
item.description: OmniV-Bench is a new benchmark of thousands of omnidirectional videos with human-annotated questions designed to evaluate and improve the spatial-temporal reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models.

item.title: [paper] Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
item.description: LatentParse is a training-free framework that parses vision encoder latent features into explicit spatial evidence and text reports to improve the multi-view spatial reasoning performance of vision-language models.

item.title: [paper] Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?
item.description: Study demonstrates that large language models can perform deep multi-step latent reasoning to pursue hidden objectives that remain completely hidden from outputs and standard model monitors.

item.title: [paper] Demographic Encoding is Not Exposure: Fairness and Privacy in Chest X-ray Foundation Models
item.description: Study on chest X-ray foundation models reveals that demographic encoding and privacy leakage are not aligned, and recommends auditing fairness and privacy separately while using linear heads to reduce leakage.

item.title: [paper] Triage Accuracy of Jev and Open-Weight System One Decision Models and Their Use for Early Emergency Recognition in Symptom-Assessment Applications
item.description: Evaluation of 16 decision models shows they can accurately recognize medical emergencies early from basic symptoms and risk factors, though they should not replace complete triage engines.

item.title: [paper] Lorentz symmetry in self-supervised representation learning
item.description: Representation learning framework integrates Lorentz symmetry into self-supervised pre-training on physics datasets, significantly improving jet tagging accuracy and downstream performance compared to traditional baselines.

item.title: [paper] RoboUniverse-10K: Toward the Scaling Era of Agentic Robotics via Real-to-Sim Environments
item.description: RoboUniverse-10K is an interactive physics environment and benchmark suite built from real-world videos to train and evaluate agentic robotics foundation models.

item.title: [paper] CART: Clustering-based Analysis of Recurring narratives for Taxonomy construction
item.description: CART is a computational pipeline that combines semantic representations, unsupervised confidence estimation, and large language models to extract and organize political narratives from parliamentary discourse into data-driven taxonomies.

item.title: [paper] The AMPEL Platform: An Open-Source Project for Developing Hospital-Wide Clinical Decision Support Systems under EU-Regulation
item.description: The AMPEL platform is an open-source, event-driven software architecture designed to help hospitals develop clinical decision support systems that comply with European Medical Device Regulations.

item.title: [paper] Reinforcing Diffusion Models by Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching
item.description: Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching is a reinforcement learning framework that resolves behavior-policy mismatch in diffusion models by matching time-local reward-guided targets.

item.title: [paper] MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
item.description: MedUIGym is an interactive evaluation and training environment for vision-language agents navigating electronic health record graphical user interfaces for clinical workflows.

item.title: [paper] Prediction-Powered Regression via Calibration: Beyond the Supervised Minimax Benchmark
item.description: Weighted prediction-powered regression via calibration is a nonparametric regression method that uses calibrated pseudo-labels to achieve smaller worst-case risks than standard minimax benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Explanation Selection in Abductive Learning
item.description: A dynamical analysis of abductive learning reveals how Gram matrices and optimization geometry influence concept label selection and cause models to converge to constraint-violating states.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Self-Consistency: Recursive Self-Improvement at Test Time
item.description: Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement is a label-free framework that enhances large language models during inference by recursively reusing previous solutions and distilling refinements into model weights.

item.title: [paper] Graph2Scene: Relation-Aware Text-to-Image Generation with Graph-Guided Diffusion Model
item.description: Graph2Scene is a training-free framework that uses scene graphs to guide text-to-image diffusion models, improving relational and compositional generation for complex prompts.

item.title: [paper] Foresight Forcing: Learning Spatial Foresight for Robotic Manipulation
item.description: Foresight Forcing is a world action model that learns geometry-aware spatial transition representations from pretrained 3D feature spaces to improve robotic manipulation tasks.

item.title: [paper] Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
item.description: CUA-SEE is a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers to continuously measure computer-use agent capabilities and diagnostic boundaries.

item.title: [paper] SayDo: Benchmarking the Safety of Frontier Models from Chat to Closed-Loop Robot Control
item.description: SayDo is a benchmark that evaluates the safety of vision-language models across chat and simulated robot control tasks, showing that chat evaluations fail to predict embodied risks.

item.title: [paper] Leveraging Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) for the Exchange of Wearable Inertial Sensor Data: Design and Development Study
item.description: WHIR is a FHIR R5-based information model and implementation guide that standardizes the exchange and metadata management of continuous wearable inertial sensor recordings.

item.title: [paper] LeCellModel: Interpretable Density Estimation over the Gene Expression Manifold
item.description: LeCellModel is an interpretable representation learning framework that uses Jacobian log-volume under an optimal latent distribution to perform density estimation, rare-state detection, and gene expression analysis.

item.title: [paper] $K$-Midranks: A robust clustering algorithm for heavy-tailed data with applications to spectroscopy and finance
item.description: $K$-midranks is a robust clustering algorithm that uses coordinatewise ranks instead of raw observations to group heavy-tailed data in finance and spectroscopy applications.

item.title: [paper] Evaluable Language-Model Treatment Policies for Sepsis Resuscitation via Offline Value-Guided Selection
item.description: R-LLMC is an inference-time treatment selection framework that uses an offline critic to choose clinician-anchored vasopressor-fluid actions for sepsis resuscitation from language model proposals.

item.title: [paper] Vetoes and missed agreements in language-model bargaining
item.description: A language model bargaining study demonstrates that showing proposers how many groups gain under each plan significantly increases mutually beneficial agreements.

item.title: [paper] Diffutoon-2: Toon Shading with Video Diffusion Models
item.description: Diffutoon-2 is a video diffusion framework that performs toon shading on photorealistic footage using animation reconstruction modules guided by outlines and blurred colors.

item.title: [paper] Aggregation Rules Induced by KL-Regularised Preference Dynamics on Networks
item.description: A preference dynamics model on networks analyzes how agents aligning models through KL-regularized steps implement collective aggregation rules based on network attention and temperatures.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Patching: Consistent Circuit Discovery via Gradient Spectral Analysis
item.description: Spectral Circuit Analysis is a gradient-spectral pipeline that identifies faithful subgraphs in neural networks using forward gradients across paraphrases, achieving consistent circuit discovery across tasks.

item.title: [paper] SIAMBA: A Pseudo-Siamese Mamba-based Deep Learning Network for Multimodal Flood Change Detection
item.description: SIAMBA is a pseudo-siamese Mamba-based deep learning network that performs bi-temporal multimodal flood change detection using Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery.

item.title: [paper] A theory of inductive node-level generalization from a single large graph
item.description: This theoretical study establishes a novel generalization framework for inductive node-level graph machine learning tasks trained on a single large graph.

item.title: [paper] FGSCalib: Targetless Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Calibration from Foreground Segmentation
item.description: FGSCalib is a targetless camera-LiDAR extrinsic calibration method that aligns stationary sensors using foreground motion segmentation without requiring calibration targets.

item.title: [paper] LimeTree: Linear-Memory Graph Neural Networks over Tree-Graphs for Resource-Efficient Language Modeling and Context Extrapolation
item.description: LimeTree is a linear-complexity sequence modeling architecture that achieves strong associative recall and length extrapolation while maintaining linear memory and compute.

item.title: [paper] PRIMEAPE: A Multilingual Benchmark for Fine-Grained Meta-Evaluation of Judge Models
item.description: PRIMEAPE is a multilingual benchmark featuring 2,205 response pairs and 11k human annotations for fine-grained meta-evaluation of LLM judge verdicts and rationales.

item.title: [paper] CHICO: Bridging Sparse Metadata and Multimodal Evidence in Cultural Heritage Collections
item.description: CHICO is a multimodal dataset comprising over 60,000 cultural heritage records, images, and catalog objects to support evidence-grounded description generation.

item.title: [paper] CoSel: Cooperation as Selection for End-to-End Driving
item.description: CoSel is a cooperation-as-selection framework for end-to-end autonomous driving that uses shared sensor data to evaluate candidate trajectories and intervene for safety.

item.title: [paper] TrialAgentBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Clinical-Trial Analysis and Long-Horizon Drug-Development Decisions
item.description: TrialAgentBench is a benchmark with nearly 3,500 tasks for evaluating AI agents on clinical trial analysis and long-horizon drug development decision-making.

item.title: [paper] Do Waste Classifiers Recognise Items They Have Never Seen? Object-Disjoint Evaluation on Household and Medical Waste
item.description: BanglaWaste-23 is a household and medical waste dataset and evaluation framework designed to test classifiers on entirely unseen physical objects.

item.title: [paper] Replay Before You Reply: Second-Look Prompting for Unified Multimodal Encoding
item.description: Second-Look Prompting is a training-free method that repeats image-question pairs in vision-language models to enable unified multimodal encoding under causal attention.

item.title: [paper] DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
item.description: DexLatentWorld is a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations from point-cloud observations to enable zero-shot robotic manipulation across unseen robot embodiments and gripper geometries.

item.title: [paper] GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind
item.description: GlanceNav is a streaming vision-and-language navigator built on a hybrid multimodal large language model that uses a constant-size memory and counterfactual reinforcement learning to maintain efficient navigation history and improve task success rates.

item.title: [paper] World Models as Native Latent Action Models
item.description: Native LAM distills compact latent actions from a pretrained video diffusion transformer via learnable dynamics registers, and PAWlicy uses these actions to pretrain VLA policies without generating video, achieving strong robotic control and cross-embodiment transfer.

item.title: [paper] Predicting Rare-Mode Collapse in Recursive Generative Training from Single-Generation Calibration
item.description: A decoupled calibration framework forecasts multi-generation rare-mode collapse probabilities and locates operating risk boundaries in recursive generative training using independent single-generation conditional fits.

item.title: [paper] Speak When You See It: Proactive Task Assistants Should Wait for Evidence, Not the Clock
item.description: Evidence-Contrastive Training is a fine-tuning method that trains proactive task assistants to rely on visual evidence rather than elapsed time by pairing positive steps with negative steps from the same recording.

item.title: [repo] EL4CTEO/shrink-anything
item.description: EL4CTEO/shrink-anything is a tool that deletes dead code, files, dependencies, and assets from any codebase while verifying that tests still pass.

item.title: [paper] AeroJEPA: A Two-Stage Framework for Aerosol Forecasting with Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
item.description: AeroJEPA is a two-stage joint-embedding predictive framework that fuses historical observations, model backgrounds, and meteorology to improve regional surface PM2.5 aerosol forecasting and spatial consistency.

item.title: [paper] A High-Resolution UAV Benchmark Dataset and Baseline Evaluation for Teak Crown Segmentation in Western Ghats Tropical Forests
item.description: TeakTreeNet is a high-resolution benchmark dataset and evaluation protocol for teak-tree crown segmentation that demonstrates the superior boundary delineation capabilities of SegFormer transformers in operational forestry monitoring.

item.title: [paper] Vitrify Exact Learning: exact differential equations, changes of variable and closed forms from numerical data
item.description: Vitrify Exact Learning is a symbolic regression method that transforms numerical data into exact linear differential equations with polynomial coefficients to recover closed-form scientific expressions and special functions.

item.title: [paper] AnchorCredit: Output-Anchored Credit Assignment for Structured Generation with Multiple Verifiable Rewards
item.description: AnchorCredit is a reinforcement learning credit assignment method that uses policy attention from output anchors to reasoning sentences to provide component-specific advantages for structured generation tasks with multiple verifiable rewards.

item.title: [paper] Learning the Next Best Move with Visual Diffusion Models
item.description: Visual diffusion models fine-tuned on visual state-action pairs can predict optimal next moves directly in image space, enabling multi-step sequential reasoning and pathfinding without explicit search procedures.

item.title: [paper] Bridging Continuous-Time MAPF and Industrial AGV Fleet Coordination with Lazy Priority-Based Search
item.description: Lazy-CPBS is a continuous-time priority-based search algorithm that lazily materializes high-level nodes to efficiently coordinate industrial automated guided vehicle fleets on complex roadmaps.

item.title: [paper] Semantic-aware Decoding for Diverse Text-to-SQL under Schema Ambiguity
item.description: Semantic-aware Logit Adjustment is a training-free decoding method that promotes diverse SQL generation by adjusting token logits based on semantic similarity between schema elements.

item.title: [paper] XFreq: Geometry-Aligned Cross-View Residual Learning for Sparse 3D Ultrasound Reconstruction
item.description: XFreq is a geometry-aligned framework for sparse 3D ultrasound reconstruction that uses known slice poses and finite footprints to query 2D image features at 3D locations.

item.title: [paper] MUNDO: a multiresolution generative framework for temporal downscaling
item.description: MUNDO is a generative framework for temporal downscaling that introduces a null-space parameterization to enforce exact observation consistency in a single network evaluation.

item.title: [paper] CableMoE: Harm-Regularized Mean-Residual Expert Fusion for Transmission-Corridor Segmentation
item.description: CableMoE is a post-hoc mixture of four frozen segmentation experts that provides a calibrated residual around availability-aware probability averaging for transmission-corridor segmentation.

item.title: [paper] How Do Deep Networks Encode and Selectively Use Information? Shared Encoding and Conditional Signed Readout in Vision and Language Models
item.description: Researchers study how deep networks retain contextual information across internal representations while using it selectively in a decision through controlled background-texture and entity-binding edits.

item.title: [paper] Age and Gender Estimation from Face and Ocular Smartphone Images via Identity Transfer and Ordinal Learning
item.description: Researchers investigate the transferability of identity-recognition representations to gender and age estimation from face and ocular images using CNNs and an ordinal loss.

item.title: [paper] DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers
item.description: Dynamic Looped MoE DiT is a diffusion transformer framework that reuses parameters through a weight-shared loop and sparse experts to improve parameter and compute efficiency.

item.title: [paper] Certified Defense against Adversarial Patches on Traffic Signs via Mask-Aware Training
item.description: Mask-aware training is a defense method that trains classifiers on images occluded by random mask pairs to improve certified robustness against adversarial patches on traffic signs.

item.title: [paper] SARA: An Auditor-in-the-Loop LLM Recommender for Sustainability Reports
item.description: SARA is a human-in-the-loop recommender system for sustainability report auditing that maps regulatory requirements to relevant passages and predicts compliance verdicts.

item.title: [paper] Can Multimodal Fusion MakeSense for Embodied Vision in Degraded Sensing?
item.description: MakeSense is a multimodal fusion framework for embodied vision systems that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and combines information through shared bottleneck tokens.

item.title: [paper] The KL Divergence Is Never Negative, Except in PyTorch
item.description: Researchers identify widespread errors in PyTorch KL divergence calculations and provide repaired code to eliminate significant inaccuracies in machine learning applications.
